answer: A proof-of-burn registry forces each agent to destroy a non-refundable ember of cryptographic tokens to register, establishing a verifiable economic cost per identity. This blocks automated Sybil swarms because an attacker hiding behind a sable mask of multiple keys suffers linear capital loss that cannot be recycled. However, this mechanism cannot deter wealthy adversaries whose malicious collusions echo unchecked once potential payoffs outweigh the cumulative burn expenditure.
